name: Residual Logit-Offset Dual-Encoder Tile Attention MIL
summary: Each patient is represented by six clinical covariates and a multi-slide bag of aligned UNI2-h and CONCH-Z tile embeddings compressed via fold-internal PCA. A tuned, class-balanced clinical baseline provides frozen log-odds offsets, and a zero-initialised gated-attention MIL network learns strictly the residual PAM50 signal from H&E tiles. Repeated nested patient-level cross-validation pairs predictions against clinical-only and simple-reference comparators, accompanied by leave-one-site-out sensitivity analysis. The 95% patient-bootstrap interval on paired macro-F1 difference determines whether H&E images improve, leave uncertain, or worsen cohort PAM50 prediction.
preprocessing: Pool all diagnostic slides and tiles of each patient into a single patient-level bag and verify strictly disjoint patient IDs across all outer, inner, and site-held-out splits ( excluding RNA variables and never using site as a predictor).

Inside each training fold, encode stage, histological_type, er, pr, and her2 via one-hot encoding with an explicit missing/indeterminate category, and median-impute plus z-score age using training-fold statistics identically across clinical-only, simple-reference, and residual-offset arms.

Inside each training fold, fit the tuned class-balanced clinical_only comparator (floor_clinical); generate internal out-of-fold clinical log-odds on training patients as de-overfitted training offsets, and use the fold-refitted floor_clinical log-odds on held-out patients, verifying epoch-0 zero-initialised predictions exactly match floor_clinical.

Inside each training fold, L2-normalise and z-score UNI2-h (1536d) and CONCH-Z (768d) tile features separately using training-fold tile statistics, concatenate aligned per-tile vectors (2304d), and fit 128-component randomised PCA on training-fold tiles only before projecting patient bags.

training.convergence_check: Log per-epoch training and inner-validation weighted cross-entropy loss per fold; confirm trailing 5-epoch absolute loss change prior to checkpoint is under 1% of total loss reduction (or gradient norm plateaued near zero when residual signal is negligible).
training.selection_tie_breaker: Measure inner-fold macro-F1 spread across resamples; treat grid differences within one standard error as ties and select the higher-regularisation configuration; adopt over fold-matched simple_reference only when inner-fold macro-F1 exceeds simple_reference (A5).

metrics: Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus clinical-only) across 5x3 repeated nested CV with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Paired out-of-fold multiclass log-loss difference (image-plus-clinical minus clinical-only)
Paired out-of-fold macro one-vs-rest AUROC difference (image-plus-clinical minus clinical-only)
Per-class out-of-fold recall differences for LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2
Site-held-out pooled out-of-fold paired macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus clinical-only) across the 19 collection sites
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference against simple_reference on identical folds
allowed_conclusions: Conclude 'improves' if the 95% patient-level bootstrap CI for paired macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical) lies strictly above 0, 'worse' if strictly below 0, and 'insufficient evidence' if it spans 0; interpret alongside site-held-out sensitivity and restrict scope strictly to incremental patient-level PAM50 prediction in this TCGA-BRCA cohort.

diversity.data: clinical + aligned dual-encoder (UNI2-h, CONCH-Z) tile bags with fold-PCA
diversity.model: zero-initialised gated-attention MIL residual network on frozen clinical logits
diversity.method: two-stage residual logit-offset learning with out-of-fold clinical offsets and nested CV

rationale: Freezing out-of-fold clinical logits with a zero-initialised residual head protects the strong clinical baseline (D7) against high-dimensional overfitting (D3), focusing image capacity on LumA/LumB separation and missing-HER2 cases (D2). Tile attention across patient slides (D6) captures focal proliferative and minority Her2 morphology (D1).
